selection_basis: Three fixed illustrative block sizes chosen before simulations; no data-driven selection. 40 ensures at least five blocks for length 8.
resource_budget: 48 cells x 20 trials x four methods x 100 resamples; local process time limit 180 seconds
stream_policy: Distinct hash-derived DGP seed for each effect/phi/n/noise/master/trial; methods use shared observed sample but distinct resampling streams.
